subject: Archer/Vendr onboarding: log retention & evidence artifacts
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha@vendr.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Archer onboarding: initial evidence checklist and log-retention ask

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for agreeing to get GreenLeaf Labs set up in Vendr/Archer. Quick kickoff note — the Archer onboarding team needs a few targeted artifacts to complete the security profile and enable the evidence upload role in the portal. Can you provide the following within the next 5 business days?

- Confirmed log retention policy (retention windows for system logs, auth logs, and application access logs).
- A redacted syslog manifest showing sample entries and retention timestamps (CSV ok).
- S3 snapshot manifest showing where archived logs are stored (bucket paths + object dates).
- KMS rotation proof (audit export or rotation events) or a signed attestation if the export is restricted.
- SOC 2 Type II report link (we can accept a secure link with expiry).

If certain items need to be redacted for IP/privacy reasons, we accept redacted samples as long as timestamps, object keys, and retention metadata are present. I've attached the Vendr onboarding checklist and will provision an "evidence-uploader" role in the portal once we can validate the artifacts.

Portal link for uploads: https://app.vendr.com/portal/greenleaf/onboard
HubSpot ticket: HS-49821

Attachments: vendr_onboarding_checklist.pdf (checklist + expected format)

Thanks — will put a small window on the role (48-hour expiry) after verification unless you request longer.

Samantha Li
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Vendr
Samantha.Li@vendr.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@vendr.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding: initial evidence checklist and log-retention ask

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear checklist and the portal link. Looping in Mina (security) and Ben (ops) to surface the exact artifacts. A couple quick clarifying items before we assemble files:

- For KMS rotation proof, do you need the raw CloudKMS audit-export CSVs, or will an HMAC-signed attestation from our security team suffice? We typically treat raw rotation logs as restricted and prefer to share via time-limited S3 links.
- Retention windows: are you asking for the policy text (e.g., "logs retained 365 days for syslog, 90 days for app-access") or the actual retention metadata per object? We can provide both; we'll prepare a short policy doc + an S3 manifest with retention metadata.

We can upload a redacted syslog manifest now (sample rows + timestamps) and a corresponding S3 manifest snapshot. Full KMS rotation exports would require a short PA/NDA — happy to reason about a limited access link if required.

Attaching: redacted_syslog_manifest.csv (sample rows)

If the portal supports direct upload of time-limited links (preferred), we'll put manifests in a time-limited S3 share and provide the link. Otherwise we can drop the files into the portal directly.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Manager, Security Programs | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@vendr.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding: initial evidence checklist and log-retention ask

Hi Samantha — Mina here (Security & Compliance). Thanks for the checklist. We can provide the following artifacts this week:

1) S3 manifest snapshot (s3_manifest_snapshot.csv) — lists object keys, creation dates, and lifecycle/retention tags. Redactions applied to object prefixes where necessary.
2) KMS rotation export (kms_rotation_export.csv) — contains key_id, rotation_timestamp, and rotation_trigger. If you need raw CloudKMS audit logs, we can provide an export to a secure, time-limited bucket; otherwise the CSV summary should suffice for mapping to CAIQ/KMS controls.
3) SOC 2 Type II — we will share a secure expiring link to the report (soc2_type2_secure_link.txt).
4) CAIQ/SIG mapping doc (we can map LOG and KMS sections to the artifacts).

Two asks from our side to make the portal workflow smooth:
- Please provision an "evidence-uploader" portal role to priyom_das@redwood.com and mina_haddad@redwood.com for 72 hours once the HS ticket is created.
- Confirm which CAIQ sections you want populated: we're planning to populate LOG-1 (Audit logging), LOG-2 (Retention), KMS-1/KMS-2 (Key lifecycle + rotation) and APP-4 (Application access logs). If Archer needs specific question IDs, send them over and we'll map artifacts to question IDs in the portal.

Attachments included: s3_manifest_snapshot.csv, kms_rotation_export.csv

Ben — can you prepare the time-limited S3 share and generate presigned URLs for the SOC2 report and KMS export?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Samantha Li <samantha@vendr.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Archer Onboarding <onboarding@archer.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer onboarding: initial evidence checklist and log-retention ask

Thanks, all — this is perfect.

We can accept the redacted manifests and time-limited S3 links. Notes and next steps:

- I've created HS-49821 and linked the ticket to GreenLeaf's portal workspace. Portal role provisioning: evidence-uploader granted to priyom_das@redwood.com and mina_haddad@redwood.com for 72 hours starting when you confirm upload is ready. If you need the role extended, request via this thread and we'll re-open a 24-hour window.
- CAIQ mapping: please map artifacts to these question IDs — LOG.1.1, LOG.1.3, KMS.2.1. We'll accept your suggested mapping in a CSV or in the portal form.
- For KMS rotation: the summary CSV is fine for verification; if we need raw audit events we will request an expanded proof and a brief justification.
- Upload link: https://app.vendr.com/portal/greenleaf/onboard (same as before). We also accept presigned S3 URLs; if you include them in the HS ticket we'll attach them to the evidence items.

Attachments: portal_role_instructions.txt (how to accept role + upload steps)
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company.com/ticket/HS-49821

Would it be possible to have the S3 manifests and SOC2 link by end of day Thursday (2027-11-04)? That will keep our onboarding timeline intact.

Onboarding Team, Vendr
Samantha Li
samantha@vendr.com
